verdict.rationale: Gemini Notebook is a SaaS research product that could plausibly expose a programmatic API, so this axis applies. The evidence pack covers only UI features (sources, chat, audio and video overviews, notes, sharing, exports) and never mentions a public API, API versioning, or a deprecation policy. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
